# ```mermaid fences in a Markdown document: diagrams, drawn in a page of
# their own and set into the document (which runs no script itself); one
# Mermaid can't draw shows why, with its source. tests/run.sh copies
# tests/fixtures/diagrams.md to @DIR@.
open:@DIR@/diagrams.md
page-wait
expect-diagrams:1
expect-page:Couldn't draw this diagram
expect-page:this is not a diagram
# Nothing of the label's picture (its handler, its address elsewhere) is left.
page-js:String(!!document.querySelector('.mermaid img, [onerror]')) ==> false
# Saved again: drawn at once from what was drawn before.
shell:printf '\nMore text.\n' >> @DIR@/diagrams.md
expect-page:More text.
expect-diagrams:1
